svg.title: PlayStation 5 DualSense wireless controller
svg.desc: Straight-on front view of a white Sony PS5 DualSense wireless controller: white two-tone shell with a black inner section, touch pad with light bar, two analog sticks, directional buttons, triangle, circle, cross and square buttons, PS button, mute button, create and options buttons, L1/R1 bumpers and L2/R2 triggers.
